title: Safe default privacy posture with one first-run consent
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Default to local-only until the human consents once to cloud use (presets: local-only, allowlisted clouds, open); the choice persists and is never asked again unless policy changes. Tests zc_privacy_default_*.
